reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread in #central-team: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

The answer came from her own June 9 message in #central-team, which she and the rest of the Central team can see. She wrote that Pine Crossing's morning receiver saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. Hollis then said he would check the shift template and have support try to reproduce the problem using the store's login.

In the reply I also said I found no later message in that channel saying the problem was fixed. I took "site" to mean the store's name. If her sheet needs something else, like a site code or address, I didn't find one in what she can see.

I didn't check the gbrain knowledge base or use message search, because their results include channels and files Pree can't see.
